reply.summary: Siamo is a bald, black-eyed fighting machine who hates losing and boasts that metal beats flesh. He abducts rivals over a game defeat, yet cannot service his own weapons.

feats.scene: Siamo punches a steel stadium gate clean off its hinges.
Siamo takes a rival's full-power blast on his chest plate and keeps boasting.

reply.summary: Lloleo is a black-haired giant condemned to shoulder the whole world for eternity. His endless stamina is lent out to mortal champions.

feats.scene: Lloleo hoists a sliding continental plate back into place with his shoulders.
Lloleo carries the planet's full mass year after year without buckling.

reply.summary: Ntitirser is a yellow-eyed star-reader forced to prop up the sky after a lost war, later fooled into hoisting it once more. He escapes, hides, and is battered by a maddened hero testing new limits.

feats.scene: Ntitirser throws off a collapsing rock ceiling that buries a whole valley.
Ntitirser lies in rubble after a long beating, battered but alive.

reply.summary: Unauora is a purple-eyed waitress from a hidden underground people who was sent up to blend in and nudge humanity toward kinder habits. Her powers over stone keep growing, and she is still puzzled by surface customs.

feats.scene: Unauora raises a wall of bedrock that stops a stampede of cars at an intersection.
Unauora walks out of a collapsed parking garage, stone dust on her apron.

reply.summary: Aulrni is a blond sea-city dweller and aunt to a future ruler. Quiet and calm, she moves through the tide streets with grace.

feats.scene: Aulrni pushes a stuck sea-gate open with both arms.
Aulrni swims through crushing deep pressure with no effort.

reply.summary: Isnusest is a far-future scientist whose experiment spawned a living pocket cosmos that threatened ours. He can shrink and split his body into particles, and carries the loss of a lover across the gap.

feats.scene: Isnusest bursts his body into particles to rip apart a swelling singularity's wall.
Isnusest reforms unscathed after a blast that erased his lab.
Isnusest slips into the small realm and races across it at near light speed.

reply.summary: Anoraau is a black-haired hero who shrinks to any size down to the unseen. He fights alongside an alliance until his whole world is wiped away.

feats.scene: Anoraau grows suddenly mid-punch to shove an enemy through a doorway.
Anoraau shrinks away from a falling wall and escapes unharmed.

reply.summary: Terulli is a masked criminal who wears a helmet that bends matter and hurls bursts of force. She shouts a chirpy warning at foes before beating them down.

feats.scene: Terulli blasts a parked van into a wall.
Terulli stumbles from a thrown crate but keeps firing.

reply.summary: Rneaunce is a grey-eyed red-haired queen of a world inside a speck. After outsiders crack open her membrane, she marches a particle army across the border in vengeance.

feats.scene: Rneaunce fires a light lance that incinerates a city block's worth of buildings.
Rneaunce shrugs off a siege-gun shell in her armoured throne.

reply.summary: Stnanval is a green-eyed empress of a microscopic planet who bends minds and changes size at will. When her homeland is captured by a stranger, she swears total annihilation on the larger world.

feats.scene: Stnanval swells to the size of a tower and kicks a bus into a river.
Stnanval takes a tank round while giant-sized and glares back.

reply.summary: Lluvelu is a skull-faced brute who glows with deadly radiation and brags he has grown far stronger since his last defeat. He is out to level a city and settle an old grudge.

feats.scene: Lluvelu unleashes a green-white blast that flattens several blocks of towers.
Lluvelu walks through a missile volley in a haze of glare.

reply.summary: Tirar is a red-skinned, yellow-eyed zealot who claims to talk with destiny. Freed from long captivity, he hunts the servants of his jailers across the stars.

feats.scene: Tirar burns a crimson crater into a moon's surface.
Tirar stands in a blast that cooks the ground around him.

reply.summary: Rnnia is a widower and avenger from a ruined world who founded a legion fuelled by rage. He roars that he is hatred itself and means to topple the dwarfish tyrants who erased his people.

feats.scene: Rnnia vomits a flood of red flame that melts an entire fortress ridge.
Rnnia is hammered by a starship cannon and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Montaore is a crimson-skinned commander who leads a rage-powered order from his homeworld until it throws him out. He tries to recruit a cosmic knight and is rebuffed by willpower.

feats.scene: Montaore hurls a ring-forged wave of fury through a space station's hull.
Montaore stands up inside a collapsing hangar with only singed skin.

reply.summary: Eoileli is a blocky toy-brick version of a red-faced vengeful commander, shouting for payback and carrying a power battery. His ring makes shields, bolts, and bricks.

feats.scene: Eoileli fires a red bolt that blows a hole in a plastic wall.
Eoileli pops back together after a giant block lands on him.

reply.summary: Tonone is a blond, green-eyed sister who once clipped the life-line of every mortal and lost most of her force when the great loom was smashed. She spends her last days gathering fragments across time.

feats.scene: Tonone snips a glowing cord and a warlord drops dead in the middle of a charge.
Tonone walks through a chamber of shattering time-glass untouched.

reply.summary: Teson, eldest among three weavers, is a white-haired, half-blind crone who cuts the silver thread of each life with shears. She also witnesses a trial and sews a famous costume.

feats.scene: Teson clips a silver thread and an entire dynasty ends in a single night.
Teson sits unmoved while a storm tears the roof from her workshop.

reply.summary: Iaraul is a shearer born of necessity, one of three sisters who sever the threads that bind mortals to destiny. She sits between a mountain hall and the underworld, scissors always ready.

feats.scene: Iaraul slices a shining thread and a war ends mid-battle.
Iaraul does not flinch as a god's thunderbolt strikes her loom.

reply.summary: Sereonast is a fanatic who lost his mother and decided blood-drinkers were behind it. He stalks masked heroes in a lonely castle, convinced that the whole town sleepwalks under a hidden king.

feats.scene: Sereonast drives a wooden stake through a tabletop in a rage.
Sereonast is thrown across a hall and stands up, ranting.

reply.summary: Vauosaial is a black-haired soldier from an eastern country who serves in a covert flying unit. He is loyal, dependable, and tough in a firefight.

feats.scene: Vauosaial fires a rifle burst through a barn door.
Vauosaial takes a grenade near-miss and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Sonauran is a huge green-eyed trader who lands on worlds with swarms of drones and hauls away landmarks to sell. He juggles dozens of deals at once and laughs off missile fire.

feats.scene: Sonauran lifts a whole island prison off its foundation with his drones.
Sonauran ignores a squadron of missiles striking his chest.

reply.summary: Seiareo is a bald bodyguard who shadows her spouse everywhere with a curved sword on her back. She is calm, protective, and ready for a scuffle.

feats.scene: Seiareo slices a metal pipe in half with a blade.
Seiareo shields her charge and takes a hard blow on her back.

reply.summary: Tortocis is a brilliant physicist infected with a lethal virus, forced to lead a secret crew of operatives in exchange for a cure. When he turns on his handlers, they stage a deadly crash.

feats.scene: Tortocis smashes a lab window with a stool to escape a trap.
Tortocis survives a bomb scare, only to meet a final aircraft disaster.

reply.summary: Niltiulu is a quiet scientist who ends up in a goofy crossover with a talking dog and his friends. Cheerful and brainy, he builds gadgets rather than throwing punches.

feats.scene: Niltiulu slams a lever and starts a clanking contraption.
Niltiulu is covered in cartoon soot and shrugs.

reply.summary: Rnres is a sickly housemaid who hosts a psychic parasite that guards her small town at the price of children. Blind to the horror, she attacks agents who come looking, until another host ends her.

feats.scene: Rnres hurls a federal agent through a kitchen window.
Rnres takes a thrown lamp and does not notice.

reply.summary: Tasolura is a stranded alien emissary who has lived for generations by passing himself off as his own descendants. Persuaded to become a public champion, he flies, moves fast enough to leave afterimages, and hits hard enough to shake the timeline.

feats.scene: Tasolura slugs a cosmic powerhouse and rattles time itself.
Tasolura stays on his feet through an explosion that levels a hillside.
Tasolura tears across the sky in a blur of afterimages.

reply.summary: Llutuler is a visitor from another star, raised by a loving household and now a well-known costumed defender. Fast enough to blur, strong enough to cause tremors, he flies above his adopted metropolis.

feats.scene: Llutuler punches a rival so hard that the shockwave levels a stretch of warehouses.
Llutuler walks out of a collapsing tower unmarked.
Llutuler streaks across the horizon in seconds.

reply.summary: Ternu is a white-haired widow with a talent for pilots' work and gadgets who commands a flying ship and a gang. She builds odd devices to carry out cartoonish crimes.

feats.scene: Ternu fires a gadget cannon that dents a train carriage.
Ternu bounces off a pile of pillows during a cartoon crash.

reply.summary: Siantsor is a brown-haired craftswoman from a warlike underworld who builds sentient boxes with an old inventor. She uses one to conjure dancing illusions, a joy that gets her arrested and tortured.

feats.scene: Siantsor conjures a ring of dancing phantoms that scatters a patrol.
Siantsor endures a long interrogation before collapsing.

reply.summary: Iuman is a metal-skinned, white-eyed clone built to carry a hero's genetic code. He rebels against his makers, leaves the planet, and dies fighting a mass murderer in deep space.

feats.scene: Iuman rips a hatch off a starship and hurls it at a pursuer.
Iuman is slammed through an asteroid ridge and sits up.

reply.summary: Nauneeo is a white-eyed blond mobster on a villainous team who flies and fires bolts of shaped light. She is knocked cold by a hero's glowing boxing glove.

feats.scene: Nauneeo blasts a vault door off its frame with a bolt.
Nauneeo is slammed into a wall by a giant glowing fist and drops.

reply.summary: Elarte is a brown-eyed time traveller, child of an angelic father and a human detective, who comes back to confront the parent who vanished. Half-heavenly, she is among the mightiest beings that exist but lets rage steer her.

feats.scene: Elarte stretches her wings and a cathedral of light splits a mountain range.
Elarte stands in a burst of celestial flame and walks out singed.

reply.summary: Lanterle is a black-haired gunslinger who floats and sometimes believes herself a different bounty hunter. With a twin, she is known for fast draws across two continents.

feats.scene: Lanterle shoots a row of bottles while floating upside down.
Lanterle takes a barroom brawl hit and fires back.
Lanterle glides across a plaza ahead of a posse.

reply.summary: Lomitia is a black-haired goddess of first light who lends an unbreakable hide to a young hero. Her sunrise glow is patient and unconquered.

feats.scene: Lomitia raises a dawn so bright it scorches a plain from rim to rim.
Lomitia stands in a thunderstorm of divine fire and is not marked.

reply.summary: Amovi is a bald knife-sharpener who drifts into obsession over a rich man's daughter and becomes a killer. His house calls turn into abductions and a twisted love story.

feats.scene: Amovi drives a blade through a wooden door in a single stab.
Amovi takes a punch from a drug dealer and does not stagger.

reply.summary: Cinanres is a bald ruler of a jungle planet where saplings become giants within moments and clocks run oddly. He kidnaps famous warriors to see whether humans are too clever to conquer, until a salty snack and some fans undo him.

feats.scene: Cinanres floods an arena with fast-growing vines that rip up the stands.
Cinanres shrugs off a thrown spear.

reply.summary: Eostaseo is a violet-eyed, sharp-nosed ally of a criminal sibling whose metal claws can reshape into surgical blades. She slices through armour with them.

feats.scene: Eostaseo carves a gouge across a steel plate with her claws.
Eostaseo is thrown down a stairwell and snarls back up.

reply.summary: Irnil is a researcher of time and quantum drift who helps time-hopping visitors avoid causing more tangles. Once granted a share of a speed force, she can run like lightning.

feats.scene: Irnil bowls through a lab door at full tilt and splinters it.
Irnil tumbles across a floor at speed and pops up laughing.
Irnil races down a corridor faster than sound.

reply.summary: Rontilleo is a grey-haired tycoon who poses as his town's benefactor while he plots to drain a bayou dry. He has buried a family's worth of grief and secrets in the mud.

feats.scene: Rontilleo orders a bulldozer through a cabin wall to clear land.
Rontilleo walks away from a car spinout with a cut lip.

reply.summary: Iartirni is a bald sound engineer who hides orders inside music and drives executives to despair. He is brought down when a rival wears earplugs and shoots him.

feats.scene: Iartirni tampers with a radio and sends a listener stumbling toward a ledge.
Iartirni is clubbed by a guard and keeps humming.

reply.summary: Sornel is a brown-eyed teenager who throws sparks and lives as a fugitive with her adopted siblings. They refuse separation, each choosing a codename.

feats.scene: Sornel discharges a bolt that blows a transformer apart.
Sornel is shocked by her own overload and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Anistiu is a folksy gas-station owner who secretly has a sharp mind and built a clever search tool. A former soldier, he feeds intel to a friend with a hidden double life.

feats.scene: Anistiu swings a wrench at an intruder.
Anistiu takes a shove into a shelf and keeps typing.

reply.summary: Stter is a red-haired genius born of generations of breeding experiments, who stopped needing sleep, food, and aging, and healed wounds by will. A wheel-bound adventurer and doctor of many fields, he gathers the strange to fight horrors.

feats.scene: Stter rigs a machine that explodes a monster's nest with a single switch.
Stter heals a deep wound by concentration and keeps going.

reply.summary: Ntvosntu is a balding corporate physician who examines blood samples in a private lab. He stands in a doorway and tries to stop a powerful visitor from taking them.

feats.scene: Ntvosntu shoves a lab door shut with both hands.
Ntvosntu is brushed aside and slides across the tiles.

reply.summary: Nauliau is a grey-eyed young prankster who steals his father's gadgets and embraces a family streak of madness. His acid gun and tricks are flashy, but his punchlines need work.

feats.scene: Nauliau detonates a prank bomb that blows out a shop front.
Nauliau tumbles from a rooftop onto a awning and giggles.

reply.summary: Auliuna is a blond crook who takes over a dead jester's gear, escapes prison with a gang, and then sells them out. His reward is a trip into a mirror world and a bad end.

feats.scene: Auliuna blasts a hole in a cell wall with a gadget.
Auliuna is thrown through a glass pane and keeps scheming.

reply.summary: Tiulle is a blond trickster expelled from a crew for spying who tries to rejoin a rebel fight. He befriends a confused monster by lying to it and is dropped from the sky for his trouble.

feats.scene: Tiulle throws a punch and hits a wall instead.
Tiulle is flung across a battlefield and lands in a heap.

reply.summary: Telnumni is a toy-brick prankster in anti-gravity boots who joins two villain gangs. He mixes acrobatics, blasts, and photography into slapstick crime.

feats.scene: Telnumni blows apart a plastic bank vault with a stack of bricks.
Telnumni shatters into bricks and snaps back together.

reply.summary: Rnoriria is a blond, small-framed delinquent from a wealthy home who lifts a trickster's costume and gadgets. He ropes into a crew, is caught by a teen sidekick, and later joins a bigger gang.

feats.scene: Rnoriria blows a storage locker door off with a stolen device.
Rnoriria takes a kick from a teen hero and wheezes.

reply.summary: Ntnaulia is a blue-eyed operative who tails a person of interest for an elite team. Trained in close combat and weapons, he follows orders without fuss.

feats.scene: Ntnaulia drives a knife hand through a stack of bricks.
Ntnaulia takes a bat across the back and completes his surveillance.
